reviewer: Primary agent source/lifecycle review with direct reproductions; not an independent agent or native-target run.

accepted_close_method.cause: Accepted stream copied read/write but re-read mutable raw.close at cleanup.
accepted_close_method.fix: Capture close with accepted read/write; cleanup invokes captured function with its receiver. Late never-accepted ports still use bounded best-effort own close discovery.

reproduction_source.note: Private own-code snapshot with only import URLs changed to absolute file URLs for isolated reproduction.

accepted_close_method.regression: accepted read/write/close methods are captured before a mutable provider changes them

failure_metadata.cause: Returned runtime Error was the same mutable object used by later snapshot.errorCode.
failure_metadata.fix: Keep only a frozen controlled code/message record; provider text and mutable Error reference never escape.
failure_metadata.regression: write failures close the opened stream without another endpoint or raw error exposure; browser failure metadata also checked.

additional_contract_checks: Explicit null setTimer/clearTimer rejected rather than silently defaulted.
Error constructor accepts only own known message codes; inherited prototype keys and coercion objects fall back to controlled SESSION_INTERNAL.
final_validation: node-tests.log:335/335 after all production fixes, browser-session-smoke.json rerun after portable failure fix.
